Senses.Note: The Song of Realizing the Way is Yongjia Xuanjue’s verse work, circulated, quoted, tested, and credited with precipitating recognition in later records. The corpus treats it as a textual object whose lines can be raised in an encounter, not merely as a catalogue heading.

The corpus treats it as a textual object whose lines can be raised in an encounter, not merely as a catalogue heading.
EvidenceBody: The compiler says Yongjia composed one Song of Realizing the Way.
Dahui says a version of the song circulates and states what its essentials do not exceed.
The compiler records awakening on hearing a neighbor recite the song.
The compiler introduces a line from the song as evidence in an argument.
The collection raises a line from Yongjia's song and follows it with masters' counter-verses.
